title: Rating
description: Request body for PUT /api/players/{name}/rating?gameType={gameType}. Used by the game server to push a single (player, gameType) rating back to the stats server — the backup channel for when the primary path (match envelopes) is missed or delayed. The consumer's stats server is eventually-consistent: it stores match envelopes when received, accepts pushes when received, and uses `updatedAt` to discard out-of-order writes (an older push never clobbers a newer match-ingest result).

gamesPlayed.description: Number of games played in this gameType through updatedAt.

updatedAt.description: Game-server-local timestamp when this rating was last updated. The consumer compares against its stored row and only writes when this is newer; older pushes return 200 with accepted=false.
